Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing an aquatic rehabilitation zone on Hood Canal.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to aquatic rehabilitation zones; adding a newchapter to Title 90 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An aquatic rehabilitation zone isestablished. The aquatic rehabilitation zone shall include allcounties that border Hood Canal bounded by a line projected from TalaPoint in Jefferson county to Foulweather Bluff in Kitsap county. (2) The provisions of this chapter apply only to aquaticrehabilitation zones. Aquatic rehabilitation zones shall be governedexclusively by the provisions of this chapter and by provisions inother chapters that are expressly applied to aquatic rehabilitationzones.
Section 1 of this act constitutes a newchapter in Title 90 RCW.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of the p. 1 HB 1060state government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
